sitedescription: From Tier-1 support to Systems Architect—specializing in enterprise automation, SCCM, and infrastructure optimization.

description.desc: Studied machine engineering in middle school and in the university
Started in IT providing multi-lingual support across IT Services Hungary, Getronics, and HPE.
Acted as Technical Lead for Software Distribution, managing SCCM/Altiris infrastructures.
Led customer infrastructure optimizations and OS image deployments.
Managed SCCM 2012 R2 infrastructure for 100k+ endpoints.
Architecting high-availability internal portals using ASP.NET MVC and .NET microservices.
